contexts.text: Cannot believe until he is convinced by what he can feel... AC 2588:2. AC 2588:3.
Such are borne into Hell without any conviction of being in falsity.
They suppose that anyone can easily receive if only he is convinced...
They are first convinced that they are in evil...
To convince even the natural man, if he is willing to be convinced.

To pasture all nations with a rod of iron = through truths from the sense of the letter, and at the same time by rational things from natural light, to convince those who are willing to be convinced. AR 828.
Those things of which the spirit is convinced, are allotted a place above those which, without consulting reason, enter on authority...
Conviction (a part of the manifestation of the faith of the New Church).
After conviction, (Luther) began to favour the truths of the New Church...
